Daily Devotional

July 30

10 Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness. (Isaiah 41:10 KJV)

Anyone, who is not born again and walking with the Lord, has many reasons to be fearful and afraid. This life is full of problems and traps, and without the strengthening of the Lord, one has many reasons to fear. But with the help of our Lord, He promises to strengthen us and hold us up with His right hand, so we need not fear this life (1 Corinthians 15:54-55). Thank God for such promises as these, as we, being the children of God, are assured of His protection during this life on earth. Thank you Lord.

Notice it says we are not to be dismayed also. This means that we are not to have any fear at all, as being dismayed is the beginning of being in fear. Fear is the opposite of Faith (1 John 4:18), and will cancel out our faith, and faith is what pleases God (Hebrews 11:6). With God, being my protector and Father, I can surely stay free from fear, as with the Lord being for me, who can be against me and succeed. I will place my confidence in the Lord at all times. Thank you Jesus!
